――それは、深き淵の底から生まれた。: —It was born at the bottom of a deep abyss.
そして、上へ上へと目指し、這い登ってゆく。<br>希望の奥底から生まれ、絶望の待:
And it climbs upward, ever upward.
Born from the depths of hope, it makes for the land where despair waits.
地上を目指す冷たい眼差しは、そして、今、見つめている。<br>闇深き大穴の底を目:
That cold gaze aimed at the surface is watching now.
It watches the youths heading for the bottom of the pitch-black chasm.
